snippet.title: Kotor III : The Jedi Masters Final Trailer
snippet.description: This is the full and final trailer for Knights of the Old Republic III : The Jedi Masters before release. This is a story converstion mod for Kotor 2 :The Sith Lords. See the website at www.the-jedi-masters.com for full details.
